entries.title: Job 33:1
segments: ¶"But please, Job, hear my speech, And listen to all my words.

entries.title: Job 33:2
segments: Now, I open my mouth; My tongue speaks in my mouth.

entries.title: Job 33:3
segments: My words [come] from my upright heart; My lips utter pure knowledge.

entries.title: Job 33:4
segments: The Spirit of God has made me, And the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

entries.title: Job 33:5
segments: If you can answer me, Set [your words] in order before me; Take your stand.

entries.title: Job 33:6
segments: Truly I [am] as your spokesman before God; I also have been formed out of clay.

entries.title: Job 33:7
segments: Surely no fear of me will terrify you, Nor will my hand be heavy on you.

entries.title: Job 33:8
segments: ¶"Surely you have spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the sound of [your] words, [saying],

entries.title: Job 33:9
segments: 'I [am] pure, without transgression; I [am] innocent, and [there is] no iniquity in me.

entries.title: Job 33:10
segments: Yet He finds occasions against me, He counts me as His enemy;

entries.title: Job 33:11
segments: He puts my feet in the stocks, He watches all my paths.'

entries.title: Job 33:12
segments: "Look, [in] this you are not righteous. I will answer you, For God is greater than man.

entries.title: Job 33:13
segments: Why do you contend with Him? For He does not give an accounting of any of His words.

entries.title: Job 33:14
segments: ¶For God may speak in one way, or in another, [Yet man] does not perceive it.

entries.title: Job 33:15
segments: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falls upon men, While slumbering on their beds,

entries.title: Job 33:16
segments: Then He opens the ears of men, And seals their instruction.

entries.title: Job 33:17
segments: In order to turn man [from his] deed, And conceal pride from man,

entries.title: Job 33:18
segments: He keeps back his soul from the Pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.

entries.title: Job 33:19
segments: ¶"Man is also chastened with pain on his bed, And with strong [pain] in many of his bones,

entries.title: Job 33:20
segments: So that his life abhors bread, And his soul succulent food.

entries.title: Job 33:21
segments: His flesh wastes away from sight, And his bones stick out [which once] were not seen.

entries.title: Job 33:22
segments: Yes, his soul draws near the Pit, And his life to the executioners.

entries.title: Job 33:23
segments: "If there is a messenger for him, A mediator, one among a thousand, To show man His uprightness,

entries.title: Job 33:24
segments: Then He is gracious to him, and says, 'Deliver him from going down to the Pit; I have found a ransom';

entries.title: Job 33:25
segments: His flesh shall be young like a child's, He shall return to the days of his youth.

entries.title: Job 33:26
segments: He shall pray to God, and He will delight in him, He shall see His face with joy, For He restores to man His righteousness.

entries.title: Job 33:27
segments: Then he looks at men and says, 'I have sinned, and perverted [what was] right, And it did not profit me.'

entries.title: Job 33:28
segments: He will redeem his soul from going down to the Pit, And his life shall see the light.

entries.title: Job 33:29
segments: ¶"Behold, God works all these [things], Twice, [in fact], three [times] with a man,

entries.title: Job 33:30
segments: To bring back his soul from the Pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of life.

entries.title: Job 33:31
segments: "Give ear, Job, listen to me; Hold your peace, and I will speak.

entries.title: Job 33:32
segments: If you have anything to say, answer me; Speak, for I desire to justify you.

entries.title: Job 33:33
segments: If not, listen to me; Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom."
